A '''unidentified warehouse''' on [[Level 1315/Legends|Level 1315]] in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] housed boxes of [[Nano-droid/Legends|Nano-droids]].

==History==
Around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] was framed for the murder of [[Letta Turmond/Legends|Letta Turmond]]&mdash;the [[Gender/Legends|female]] that orchestrated an [[Bombing of the Jedi Temple hangar/Legends|attack]] on the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] by feeding [[Nano-droid/Legends|Nano-droids]] to her [[Abyssin/Legends|Abyssin]] husband, [[Jackar Bowmani/Legends|Jackar Bowmani]].

The fugitive Tano&mdash;aided by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]&mdash;journeyed to this warehouse to inspect the place for the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that Turmond had used. But Ventress was attacked by [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]] who stole both her mask and her [[Asajj Ventress's lightsabers/Legends|twin lightsabers]] and then attacked Tano in the warehouse. Barriss Offee then vanished, and Tano was stunned into submission by [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[CT-3636|Wolffe]], who was on the hunt for her along with [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]].
